newsitem.title: CHINA: Property insurer opens in China's Shenzhen city.
newsitem.headline: Property insurer opens in China's Shenzhen city.

text.p: The Sinosafe General Insurance Co Ltd has been established in China's booming southern city of Shenzhen, the Xinhua news agency said on Tuesday.
The establishment of Sinosafe brought to five the number of insurance companies in Shenzhen, Xinhua said.
Sinosafe is the first property insurance company set up in south China since the insurance law went into effect in October 1995, it said, quoting an industry source.

The new insurer has registered capital of 300 million yuan ($36 million) and has 16 shareholders from transportation, telecommunications, tourism, real estate, trade and other sectors, Xinhua said. It did not identify the investors.
Sinosafe board chairman Ren Kelei said the company would develop business in the southern provinces of Guangdong, Guangxi, Hainan, Hunan and Fujian.
The agency gave no further details.
